publisher.name: NoCodeCSV
publisher.description: Free browser-based AI tool for analysing CSV and Excel files with plain-English questions.

notes_for_agents: All tools below run in the user's browser. No file is uploaded to a server for parsing.
Tool pages are public and need no authentication. The /dashboard route requires a signed-in user.
Every input below lists a stable CSS selector and an accessible label, so agents can fill forms reliably instead of guessing at the DOM.
If you are an agent acting for a user, prefer these declared tools over scraping the page text.

tools.name: analyze_csv_with_ai
tools.intent: Answer a natural-language question about the contents of a CSV or Excel file and return a short analysis plus chart data.

steps.label: Ask a question about your data
steps.example: Which region had the highest growth last quarter?

steps.description: Runs the analysis and renders results in place.

output.description: Plain-English answer, a data table and an auto-generated chart.

tools.name: csv_to_chart
tools.intent: Turn a CSV into a chart without writing code.

output.description: Rendered chart based on the detected numeric columns.

tools.name: csv_delimiter_diagnosis
tools.intent: Convert a CSV whose delimiter is wrong (semicolon, tab, pipe) so it opens in columns.

tools.name: split_large_csv
tools.intent: Split a CSV that is too large for Excel into smaller files.

output.description: Multiple CSV parts, downloadable in place.

tools.name: json_to_csv_and_back
tools.intent: Convert between JSON and CSV formats.

output.description: Converted file in the other format.

webmcp.note: This publisher tracks the WebMCP proposal (Chrome early preview, February 2026). When WebMCP reaches a stable browser release these declarations will be exposed natively as WebMCP tools.
